S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.

subtypes.With Depressed Mood: Symptoms mainly include low mood, tearfulness, or feelings of hopelessness.
subtypes.With Anxiety: Symptoms mainly include nervousness, worry, jitteriness, or separation anxiety.
subtypes.With Mixed Anxiety and Depressed Mood: A combination of depression and anxiety symptoms appears.
subtypes.With Disturbance of Conduct: Symptoms mainly involve violation of rules, truancy, vandalism, reckless driving, or fighting.
subtypes.With Mixed Disturbance of Emotions and C: Both emotional symptoms (depression, anxiety) and behavioral problems appear together.
subtypes.Unspecified: Maladaptive reactions not classified into the above types (e.g., physical complaints, social withdrawal).

patient_info.stressor: Lula Cooper’s closest choir friend and longtime co-organizer of church potlucks died suddenly a week before a major senior-center mentoring luncheon they had planned together. At first Lula tried to honor her friend by taking over every spreadsheet, menu, and phone call herself, but over the next month her emotional and behavioral response to the loss began disrupting the routines that usually grounded her, including choir rehearsals, gardening, and volunteer coordination. The church events still mattered deeply to her, yet her ability to follow through declined enough that several commitments had to be reassigned. After she missed a planning meeting she had never once missed before, Lula agreed to speak with her primary care doctor, who referred her for psychiatric evaluation.

S081.name: Stress_Related_Maladaptive_Response
S081.description: Emotional or behavioral symptoms appearing in response to an identifiable stressor.
S081.manifestation: Ever since my choir friend passed so suddenly, I just haven't been myself—I cry over the potluck lists, get all worked up about calls I used to handle easy, and I've started missing church planning things I never would have missed before.

additional_requirement_1.name: Additional Requirement 1
additional_requirement_1.description: Symptoms must develop within 3 months of the onset of the stressor
additional_requirement_1.manifestation: My friend died just about a month ago, and it was only after that sudden loss that I started falling apart with the church planning.

additional_requirement_2.name: Additional Requirement 2
additional_requirement_2.description: Within 6 months of the termination of the stressor or its consequences
additional_requirement_2.manifestation: This is all still tied to her death and the luncheon we were supposed to finish together; it has not been going on for months and months after things settled.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I have had to let other church members take over calls, lists, and parts of the luncheon because I am not keeping up the way I always did before.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about a month, since my close choir friend died.
